items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Listen, he had a good band at one time, but I'm talking about the man himself. He still is kind of off up there. He always was. That's not his real name, but we nicknamed him that, Dizzy.

ctx.x: You didn't like anything he played?
Listen, he had a good band at one time, but I'm talking about the man himself. He still is kind of off up there. He always was. That's not his real name, but we nicknamed him that, Dizzy. Yeah.
But he was playing with Frankie Fairfax, he was playing with Cab Calloway. He was playing with regular bands.
